interpretation.claim: The inspected JournalRuntimeStore can make a later-arriving older RunRecord authoritative over a newer terminal RunRecord for the same run_id.
interpretation.evidence_basis: The kill test writes newer terminal state first, then an older result, reloads through a fresh JournalRuntimeStore, and observes the older result as authoritative.
limits: This is a deterministic durable-state ordering test, not a Binder callback integration test.
The test proves arrival-order regression at the JournalRuntimeStore boundary; it does not yet prove which production callback path can produce the ordering.
No fix has been applied yet.
